fields.description: What this block holds. Each type reads only its own fields; the others are cleared on save.
fields.label: Type
fields.options:
rich_text
key_value
table
image

fields.description: Lowest first, grid row order breaks ties.
fields.label: Sort Order

fields.description: rich_text. Sanitised on save; scripts and event handlers are removed.
fields.label: Rich Text

fields.description: key_value. Edited as an ordered grid of key/value rows in its own document -- never as pasted JSON -- and reusable across products.
fields.label: Spec Group

fields.description: table. A bounded 2-6 column table edited as an ordinary grid in its own document -- never pasted JSON, and owned by this same product.
fields.label: Product Table

fields.description: image. Distinct from the product Gallery: this one sits inside a content section.
fields.label: Image

fields.description: download. A Frappe File; never a raw filesystem path.
fields.label: File

fields.description: video. An http(s) URL only. Embed HTML, iframes and scripts are refused -- the client decides how to present the URL safely.
fields.label: Video URL
